item.title: Tousaku Kyoushitsu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sargasso
  • 発売日: 2006-08-13
  • スコア: 6.29/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 倒錯教室
  • 英語名: Tousaku Kyoushitsu

あらすじ

A prestigious school has a long history of discrimination that’s called tradition here.

Main character is an ordinary boy who wakes up without memory in the health room, and woman before him claims to be his slave. He tries to watch recorded videos to restore his memory, and it shows humiliation play. In time, a new form of love is born…

item.title: Gakuen Tengoku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sargasso
  • 発売日: 2005-08-14
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 学怨天獄
  • 英語名: Gakuen Tengoku

あらすじ

Main character is being bullied by one girl every day. The scale eventually escalates to such level that he gets sexually harassed in front of the girl of his longing. He goes to the roof to commit suicide, but he is deprived even of that dignity as he is pushed by another girl coming by. He awakens as a spirit to have his revenge over bully and the girl to push him down.
